caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a swing seat suspended by a short chain. The seat is oval in shape and shaded in gray tones, with a thicker border around the edge, giving it a sense of three-dimensionality. The chain, composed of several interlocking links, is attached to one side of the seat and extends vertically upward, suggesting that the swing is hanging from an unseen support above the frame of the drawing. The background is plain and uncolored, with the paper left as the natural light beige tone throughout. In the lower right corner, there is a small, barely visible inscription or signature. The drawing is executed entirely in pencil, emphasizing line work and shading to create depth and form.
title: Iron Griddle
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
